text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp. High in the sky, 
the summer sun blazed brightly, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The faces of Twin Turbo's friends were... 
all gloomy and clouded over for their own 
reasons.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Just one step away from a major title... 
Yet it's 2nd place, 2nd place again. Why 
can't I close it out...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I somehow managed to get out of my slump, 
but now McQueen is... I wonder if she'll 
be okay..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's so rough~~★ The race schedule is way 
too packed~! I wanna run with both 
Palmer-chin and the young lady, yoー☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Will Teio and I... make it in time for 
autumn? Is it really going to be okay?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hauu~, I can't catch up~. Not to 
Bourbon-san, and not to Rice-san who's 
growing so fast, either~.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What's with you guys? Every single one of 
you is completely useless~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst all this, Twin Turbo was the only 
one still full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"You ought to take a page out of Turbo's 
book. Cheer up!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it's super rough and totally 
disastrous...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If it's Tokai Teio we're talking about, 
she wouldn't give up over something like 
that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though... even Teio's having kind 
of a rough time right now, right?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A shadow falls over Mejiro Palmer's face. 
Indeed, Tokai Teio is an Umamusume who 
truly symbolizes the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When noticeable areas sag, the whole mood 
tends to sink along with them.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see. Tokai Teio was secretly brightening 
everyone's spirits, huh.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Not just Turbo, but everyone... As 
expected of my lifelong rival...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo puts on a slightly serious 
expression.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Turbo wants to do it too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I want to brighten everyone up! Just like 
Teio!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Because you're my eternal rival! And Teio 
isn't here right now!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Instead, Turbo's gonna tell everyone 
never to give up!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A tiny hero rose to the challenge. Twin 
Turbo, who once did nothing but get left 
behind by everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All by herself, she's trying to blow away 
this gloomy atmosphere. With that tiny 
body of hers.
choice_data_list:
Then, we just have to give it our all in 
the Tanabata Sho.

Then, we just have to give it our all in 
the Tanabata Sho.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Tanabata Sho"... I want to make it a race 
that brings a smile to everyone's face...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yeah, got it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, you guys! Turbo's gonna go all out! 
I'll run a crazy front-runner race and 
crush it!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just a good run, it was an 
explosive victory! So you'd better make 
that promise.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If Turbo works hard, everyone else will 
work hard too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Twin Turbo...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have another reason why I can't lose. 
The Tanabata Sho is finally a serious 
showdown...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I must show everyone a run several levels 
above anything before and bring them hope.
